access: Read-only local reads: files and folders under the given path, and git commands (rev-parse, log, status) run inside the given repo. No network, no model calls, no writes, no config keys.
description: Context awareness for AI use: short, honest, deterministic gists of files, folders, git repos, and pasted text. No model calls, no network, stdlib only.
name: Gist

tools.description: Gist of a file: what it is, size and lines, headings, TODO/FIXME/OPEN markers with line numbers, last modified. Says so plainly when the file is missing or empty.
tools.name: gist_file

path.description: Path to the file. Relative paths resolve against the workspace.

tools.description: Gist of a folder: file and folder counts by type, README gist if one exists, newest and oldest files, what looks stale (untouched 90+ days).
tools.name: gist_folder

path.description: Path to the folder. Relative paths resolve against the workspace.

tools.description: Gist of a git repo: current branch, head commit, uncommitted change count, last 5 commits, README gist. Says so plainly when the path is not a repo.
tools.name: gist_repo

path.description: Path to the repo. Defaults to the workspace when omitted.

tools.description: Gist of pasted text: first lines, headings, and deterministically extractable TODO/DONE/OPEN/DECISION/FLAG markers, and what it could not determine. Never invents a summary the text doesn't support.
tools.name: gist_text
